stages.name: 黄金の摩天楼
stages.description: 幾何学の塔が朝日を弾く
stages.prompt: anime cinematic cityscape, stepped Art Deco skyscrapers with gold fins and spires glowing in sunrise, dramatic upward perspective, clean geometry

stages.name: 大理石のロビー
stages.description: 金の線が床に反射する
stages.prompt: beautiful anime interior, symmetrical grand lobby with black marble floor, gold geometric patterns, sunburst motifs, polished reflections, warm lighting

stages.name: 雨の大通り
stages.description: 街灯が濡れた道に流れる
stages.prompt: atmospheric anime scene, rain-slick avenue at night, streamlined vintage cars, glowing marquee signs, emerald and amber reflections, steam rising

stages.name: ジャズの夜
stages.description: 舞台が光と影で脈打つ
stages.prompt: lively anime scene, jazz club stage with brass instruments, fan-shaped golden backdrop, smoky light shafts, rich warm tones, rhythmic composition

stages.name: 屋上の夜明け
stages.description: 街が静かな青に包まれる
stages.prompt: poetic anime rooftop terrace at dawn, city of towers fading into pale blue and champagne light, calm lingering glamour

character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: sleek jet-black finger waves, golden-brown eyes, with a distinctive, recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. Character identity: a jazz-age architectural illustrator who sketches the city after dark. Signature costume: a sharply tailored black-and-champagne suit, geometric gold brooch, and polished ankle boots. Defining personal item: a slim gold fountain pen and a black sketchbook. Keep the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and signature item unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: This theme has one fixed protagonist: preserve the exact character identity in every scene.
Keep the same face, age impression, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume silhouette, materials, colors, and defining personal item consistent; do not randomly redesign the outfit.
Do not replace the protagonist or introduce another lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in stepped skyscraper skyline, marble lobby with gold geometry, rain-lit avenue with streamlined cars; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with black and gold, emerald, champagne, midnight blue; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by low-angle shot up a stepped tower, symmetrical lobby dolly-in, tracking along a rain-slick avenue; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

available_styles: low-angle shot up a stepped tower
camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
